name: Los Angeles International Airport
transfer_notes: United domestic flights (incl. HNL) operate out of the connected Terminal 7/8 complex, gates 70-88. Same-complex gate-to-gate walk.

activities.name: LAX Art Program - Terminal 7 Gallery
activities.why: Rotating installations (currently 'Awake in the Dream' by Chenhung Chen and 'The View From Above') most people walk straight past. Free, ~15-20 min, turns dead time into an actual gallery stop.

coffee.name: Klatch Coffee
coffee.why: Independent California roaster, not a chain -- their espresso won 'Best Espresso in the World' at the 2007 World Barista Championship. Globally-sourced beans, brewed to order. Closest thing to your home roasters you'll find past security.

food.name: Ashland Hill
food.why: The OG Burger (Niman Ranch beef, sharp cheddar, brioche, house pickles) is a legitimately good burger, not airport-burger-shaped trash. Also runs a breakfast/brunch menu if your connection lands earlier in the day.
